verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships the official Inso CLI for automating API test execution in Git and CI workflows. It is documented as designed for CI, with prompts disabled and exit codes that pass or fail the workflow, and the docs also cover automated collection runs and failing builds on lint errors. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Inso running collections in CI, and detail on test assertions/reporting for detecting regressions (e.g. JUnit output, specific test-run commands).
